requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 通过串口（9600 波特率）接收字符串 ON 或 OFF，控制 D13 LED 开关。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: io_1_valid=true, io_1=2 (ON) for one control step, then io_1_valid=false for subsequent steps
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_0 becomes true (LED ON) starting immediately after the ON-valid step and remains true until an OFF-valid command is received

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 通过串口（9600 波特率）接收字符串 ON 或 OFF，控制 D13 LED 开关。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: io_1_valid=false for one or more steps (no valid serial frame), then io_1_valid=true, io_1=1 (OFF) for one control step
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_0 stays at its previous value while io_1_valid=false, then becomes false (LED OFF) immediately after the OFF-valid step
